thread:
matt: Kicking off a 5% canary for inference-service v3.4.0-rc2 to eu-west now. Change window open 20:00-22:00 UTC. @ops-oncall FYI

devops-bot: deploy started: inference-service v3.4.0-rc2 -> canary(5%) [link:deploy/2612340000] :rocket:

samir: Noted. I'll watch the P95 & error-rate dashboards.

marta: Quick heads-up — models-team flipped attention-kernel fallback in this build, could affect long-context perf.

ops-oncall: Seeing a small bump in 95th latency on eu-west at t+6m, +18% vs baseline. No errors yet.

matt: Can we confirm if it's tail-only or overall? If tail, we can keep observing, but if broad degrade we pin.

samir: Quick check: tail is the main delta, but CPU saturation on two pods spiked. Logs show repeated KV cache misses around long prefixes.

jia: Replayed a subset of failing traces in staging, reproduced latency spike when prompt length > 1024. Kernel fallback triggers more CPU.

marta: That matches an off-by-one in kernel selection heuristics we pushed. Patch ready but needs bake.

ops-oncall: Ops suggests pausing traffic shift and pinning canary to v3.3.9 until patch is hotfixed.

matt: Agreed. Initiating pause and pin. Devops, please run the rollback pin command and stop additional traffic shifts.

devops-bot: action: pause-rollout canary(5%) for inference-service v3.4.0-rc2 -> HOLD by matt [cmd: /rollout pause --service=inference-service --env=eu-west --percent=5]

devops-bot: action: pin-variant inference-service -> v3.3.9 for eu-west canary (locked) [cmd: /rollout pin --service=inference-service --version=v3.3.9 --scope=eu-west-canary]

matt: Pin applied. Redirecting existing canary sessions to v3.3.9. Release notes link: https://go/redwood/releases/inference/3.4.0-rc2 (added kernel note).

samir: Running quick smoke on pinned traffic for 10 min, watching p95 and CPU.

ops-oncall: After pin, p95 down to baseline within 2m. CPU stabilized. No new errors.

marta: Will open a hotfix branch for kernel-selection and cut a 3.4.0-rc3 once validated.

matt: Decision: abort progressive canary for rc2. Hold until rc3 is validated. We'll schedule a narrow re-rollout after patch verification and a small QA bake.

jia: I'll create an eval job against the regression prompt set and post results here when done.

matt: Thanks — please post ETA for rc3 and QA pass. For now, changing release notes: status -> "paused, pinned to v3.3.9 in eu-west canary".

devops-bot: note: change window still open until 22:00 UTC. Will keep rollback lock until release lead clears.

samir: +1 on keeping lock. If rc3 arrives earlier we can quick-approve after ops + QA signoff.

marta: Targeting rc3 cut in ~3h. Will ping when artifacts uploaded.

matt: OK. Closing this stop/go: STOP for rc2 -> pin to v3.3.9. Reopen thread when rc3 ready. :white_check_mark:
